description: Inflation and CPI data by country as JSON, no API key: yearly inflation, CPI index, GDP, GDP growth, GDP per capita, unemployment, population and lending rate for 217 countries (World Bank, CC BY 4.0), plus monthly HICP inflation (yoy, mom, index) for 37 European countries from Eurostat, including the flash estimate. Adjust any amount for inflation between two years or months. Modes: latest, history, monthly, adjust. Monitor mode returns only new periods. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.01/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/inflation-cpi-api.

amount.description: For adjust: the money amount to convert, e.g. 100. Default 100.

countries.description: ISO2 (US, DE, BG), ISO3 (USA, BGR) or English names (Germany). Up to 50. Empty = US, DE, GB, JP, BG.

country.description: For adjust: one country, e.g. US or Germany. Default US.

endMonth.description: For monthly: last month YYYY-MM. Default the newest month.

endYear.description: For history: last year. Default the latest year with data.

fromMonth.description: For adjust with monthly precision (EU countries, HICP index): YYYY-MM.

fromYear.description: For adjust: the year of the original amount. Default 10 years before To year.

indicator.description: For history: one indicator key, e.g. inflation or gdpGrowth. Default inflation.

indicators.description: For latest: inflation, cpi, gdp, gdpGrowth, gdpPerCapita, unemployment, population, interestRate (or the raw World Bank code, e.g. FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG). Empty = inflation.

mode.description: latest = newest yearly value per country and indicator (EU countries also get the newest monthly HICP); history = one row per country and year; monthly = Eurostat HICP per month (EU/EEA/candidate countries); adjust = what an amount from one

startMonth.description: For monthly: first month YYYY-MM. Default 24 months back.

startYear.description: For history: first year (1960 or later). Default 10 years ago.

toMonth.description: For adjust with monthly precision (EU countries, HICP index): YYYY-MM.

toYear.description: For adjust: the target year. Default the latest year with CPI data.

name: inflation_cpi_api
title: Inflation & CPI Data API - Official Consumer Price Index by Country
